description: Designed and developed a multi-source E-commerce Intelligence platform integrating Google Analytics 4, Meta Ads, and Shopify to centralize and analyze business data.
Automated data collection and analysis through ETL pipelines and KPI dashboards to provide unified insights on marketing performance, traffic, and e-commerce activities.
Integrated LLM-based AI insights and anomaly detection to support business analysis and decision-making.
Designed and built an LLM-based chatbot prototype to analyze and interpret employee behavior data.
Integrated advanced language models (Gemma-3-12B) to process key behavioral indicators (KBI).
Automated the generation of insights from internal reporting data using RAG and NL2SQL techniques.
